No dataset here shows forest on this property in 2020.

- **JRC Global Forest Cover 2020 (V4)** is the dataset that speaks directly to 2020. It reports 0 ha of forest, or 0% of the 2,843.1 ha asset.
- **Hansen Global Forest Change (GFC-2025-v1.13)** shows about 23 ha of tree cover (≥30% canopy) in 2000. That is a historical baseline, not 2020 forest. It also records tree-cover loss events of 0.8 ha (2008), 25.5 ha (2015), 4.8 ha (2017) and 67.7 ha (2020).
